reasons.plausibility: The proposed electron–phonon coupling enhancement via short-range order is scientifically reasonable in high-entropy alloys, though details on composition-specific effects need further validation.
reasons.testability: The hypothesis provides a clear annealing-versus-control experiment with distinct structural and superconducting measurements that would decisively confirm or refute the effect of local ordering on superconductivity.
reasons.usefulness: This approach directly addresses the role of compositional ordering in the superconducting behavior of underexplored high-entropy alloys, making it a valuable and feasible line of investigation.
